items.title: Removal of Japanese Ho-Ri SPGs from the Research Tree and Sale
items.summary: Today, we’d like to give you a heads up regarding the removal of the Japanese Ho-Ri Production and Ho-Ri Prototype SPGs from the Japanese research tree and from sale respectively.

items.title: Update 2.57.1.67
